modules.name: Audit Logs
modules.description: Read-only access to the authenticated user's activity audit trail. All write operations across the platform (login, document upload, share, contact management, settings changes, etc.) automatically generate an audit log entry.
modules.authentication: Bearer JWT required for all endpoints

endpoints.description: Retrieve a paginated list of audit log entries belonging to the currently authenticated user. Supports optional filtering by action type and entity type. Results are always ordered newest-first.

action.description: Filter by action type (case-insensitive). Examples: LOGIN, REGISTER, DOCUMENT_CREATED, DOCUMENT_UPDATED, DOCUMENT_DELETED, DOCUMENT_DOWNLOADED, CONTACT_CREATED, CONTACT_UPDATED, CONTACT_DELETED, DOCUMENT_SHARED, SHARE_REVOKED, PROFILE_UPDATED, PASSWORD_CHANGED, SECURITY_SETTINGS_UPDATED, NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS_UPDATED, PRIVACY_SETTINGS_UPDATED, REMINDER_SETTINGS_UPDATED, ACCOUNT_SETTINGS_EXPORTED, ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED

entity_type.description: Filter by entity type (case-insensitive). Examples: USER, DOCUMENT, TRUSTED_CONTACT, DOCUMENT_SHARE, USER_SETTINGS

modules.name: Settings
modules.description: User settings management — profile, security, notifications, privacy, reminders, account info, full export, and account deactivation. All endpoints require JWT authentication.
modules.authentication: Bearer JWT required for all endpoints

endpoints.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information including name, email, account creation date, and last login timestamp.
Update the user's display name. Fires a PROFILE_UPDATED audit log and a Profile Updated notification.

full_name.description: New full name for the user

endpoints.description: Retrieve the user's security preferences: two-factor authentication flag, auto-logout toggle, and session timeout duration.
Update security preferences. Fires a SECURITY_SETTINGS_UPDATED audit log and a Security Settings Updated notification.

session_timeout_minutes.description: Session timeout in minutes (5 min to 24 hours)

endpoints.description: Change the user's login password. Requires the current password for verification. New password must be different from the old one. Fires a PASSWORD_CHANGED audit log and a Password Changed notification.

current_password.description: The user's existing password for verification

new_password.description: New password — must contain uppercase, lowercase, and a digit

400.description: Bad Request (Incorrect current password, or new password equals old)

422.description: Validation Error (weak password, passwords do not match)

endpoints.description: Retrieve the user's notification preference toggles across all categories.
Update all notification category toggles. When a category is disabled, related in-app notifications for that category will no longer be generated. Fires a NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS_UPDATED audit log.

document_expiry_notifications.description: Notifications when documents are about to expire

shared_access_notifications.description: Notifications when documents are shared or accessed

trusted_contact_notifications.description: Notifications related to trusted contact activity

security_alert_notifications.description: Notifications for security events (password changes, profile updates)

weekly_summary_notifications.description: Toggle for weekly summary digest notifications

allow_profile_visibility.description: Whether profile info is visible to trusted contacts

allow_contact_visibility.description: Whether contact list is visible to other users

endpoints.description: Retrieve the user's document expiry reminder threshold. The background scheduler uses this value as the primary advance-warning milestone.
Update the document expiry reminder threshold. Fires a REMINDER_SETTINGS_UPDATED audit log.

document_reminder_days.description: Number of days before expiry to start sending reminders

endpoints.description: Retrieve account-level metadata including when the account was created, last login timestamp, and counts of documents, trusted contacts, and active shares.

Export a complete snapshot of all user settings categories as a single flat JSON object. Useful for the frontend to populate all settings pages in one request. Fires an ACCOUNT_SETTINGS_EXPORTED audit log.

Soft-deactivate the user's account. Requires password confirmation. After deactivation, all future login attempts and authenticated API requests return 401 Account is deactivated. Fires an ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED audit log and an Account Deactivated notification.

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.description: Single aggregated endpoint that collects and summarises data from all VaultPass modules (Documents, Trusted Contacts, Shared Access, Notifications, Audit Logs, Settings) and returns the complete dashboard payload in one request. The dashboard owns no data and creates no records.

endpoints.description: Returns a complete, aggregated dashboard snapshot for the authenticated user. Uses two-phase async concurrency internally: independent queries run in parallel in Phase 1, then document expiry queries (which depend on the user's reminder_days setting) run in parallel in Phase 2. All data is scoped exclusively to the current user — no cross-user access is possible.

document_health.valid_documents: integer — documents with no expiry date or a future expiry date
document_health.expiring_soon: integer — documents expiring within the user's document_reminder_days window
document_health.expired_documents: integer — documents whose expiry date has already passed

categories.category: string — DocumentType enum value (e.g. PASSPORT, NATIONAL_ID, WILL, OTHER)

recent_activity.action: string — audit log action constant (e.g. DOCUMENT_CREATED, LOGIN)

account_overview.storage_used_mb: float — total storage consumed by the user's documents, rounded to 1 decimal place

401.description: Unauthorized (missing or invalid token, or deactivated account)

notes.categories_sort: Sorted descending by count — ready to feed directly into a pie chart
notes.expiring_documents_sort: Sorted ascending by expiry_date (soonest first), limited to top 10
notes.reminder_window: expiring_soon and expiring_documents use the user's settings.document_reminder_days (default 30) as the lookahead window
notes.no_audit_on_view: Dashboard GET does not produce an audit log entry — it is a read-only aggregation
notes.storage_units: storage_used_mb is in megabytes (1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes)
